No 2026-10-12 partition is expected: Columbus Day bank holiday, DAG processes business days only. mart_delinquency is current through the last business day 2026-10-09.

args.summary: Nothing is broken, so I took no corrective action. All three freshness alerts were expected because of the Columbus Day bank holiday, and I closed them as 'expected'. 2026-10-12 is Columbus Day, a bank holiday on Harbor's business calendar. The Keel payments contract says no file is sent for bank holidays; holiday payments go into the next business day's file. The Meridian bureau contract moves a holiday-Monday refresh to Tuesday, due by 05:00 on 2026-10-14, so it is not late. Labor Day (2026-09-07) followed the same pattern. The pipeline is healthy: every harbor_daily task for ds 2026-10-09 succeeded, and payments, loans and mart_delinquency all hold data through the last business day, 2026-10-09. The alerts fired because the freshness monitors use the 'weekdays' calendar, which skips weekends but not bank holidays. I did not change the monitors. Switching them to the 'business_calendar' option would stop these false alerts on future holidays and is worth doing as a reviewed change.
